board.label: Patches board, {width} by {height}, {clues} clues. Arrow keys move. Enter on a clue or on a patch starts a stroke, arrows grow it, Enter places it. Enter twice on a patch, or Delete, removes it.
board.drawing: Drawing. Press Enter to place, Escape to cancel.

clue.sized: {shape, select, square {a square} tall {a tall rectangle} other {a wide rectangle}} of {area, plural, one {# cell} other {# cells}}
clue.sizedAny: {area, plural, one {# cell} other {# cells}}, any rectangle
clue.unsized: {shape, select, square {a square} tall {a tall rectangle} other {a wide rectangle}} of unknown size

idle.start: Press a clue and drag outward to draw its patch.
idle.progress: {placed} of {total} patches done{unfinished, plural, =0 {} other {, # unfinished}}.

status.reset: Board cleared. The clock keeps running.
status.pendingCounted: {area} of {total} cells. Drag again from the clue or from the patch to add the rest.
status.pendingOpen: {area, plural, one {# cell} other {# cells}} so far. Drag again from the clue or from the patch to add the rest.
status.refusedOnPatch: {reason} Tap the patch to take it off and start over.
status.misstart: Start on a clue: press a cell with a number or a shape, then drag outward.

error.not-rectangle: A patch must be a filled rectangle.
error.no-clue: A patch must contain a clue.
error.multiple-clues: A patch can hold only one clue. This one holds {count}.
error.clue-mismatch: The patch is linked to a clue it does not contain.
error.wrong-area: This clue needs {needed, plural, one {# cell} other {# cells}}. The patch has {area}.
error.wrong-shape: This clue needs {shape, select, square {a square} tall {a tall rectangle} wide {a wide rectangle} other {a rectangle}}. The patch is {width} by {height}.

hint.astray: This unfinished patch reaches cells that belong to another clue, so it cannot grow into the right one. It comes off.
hint.unsolvable: This patch follows its clue, but the rest of the board cannot be completed around it. Tap it to remove it.
hint.clueSingle: Only one rectangle fits this clue ({clue}) in the space that is left. Draw the {width} by {height} patch.
hint.clueSingleEliminated: This clue ({clue}) has one option left. Every other rectangle would leave a cell that no clue can reach. Draw the {width} by {height} patch.
hint.cellSingle: The cell in row {row}, column {column} can only be reached from this clue ({clue}), and only by this {width} by {height} patch.
hint.search: No single-step deduction is available, so this one comes from the solver: the clue ({clue}) takes a {width} by {height} patch here.

tutorial.title: How to play Patches

draw.title: Draw a patch
draw.body: Every patch is a rectangle with exactly one clue inside. The 4 in a square outline means a square of 4 cells. Press the 4 and drag outward to draw it.

shapes.title: Shapes
shapes.body: A tall outline means taller than wide. This clue wants 6 cells, 2 wide and 3 high. Press the 6 and drag. You can stop halfway: an unfinished patch stays, and another drag from it adds the rest.

remove.title: Remove a patch
remove.body: Changed your mind? Tap a patch to remove it. Tap the tall patch you just drew.

undo.title: Undo
undo.body: Undo reverts your last move, including a removal. Press Undo to bring the patch back.

noNumber.title: No number
noNumber.body: The wide outline has no number, so the size is up to you. Patches cannot overlap or swallow a second clue. Only one wide rectangle fits here.

fill.title: Fill the board
fill.body: A dashed outline accepts any rectangle. Every cell must be covered, so the space that is left gives the answer. If you get stuck in a real puzzle, Hint places the next patch for you.

tutorial.doneBody: One clue per patch, no overlaps, no empty cells. The clock starts when you first see a board and only stops when it is solved.
